* **On PyPI for the first time**: `pip install bankstatementparser-writer-ofx`
  now works. A tag builds the sdist and wheel and publishes them through
  PyPI trusted publishing, so no API token is stored anywhere.
* **Built against core 0.0.34**: the writer requires
  `bankstatementparser >= 0.0.34`, and the coverage gate now counts
  branches as well as lines, at 100%.
* **In lockstep with the suite's 0.0.35 release**: all fourteen packages and bankstatementparser.com ship 0.0.35 together, eight of the packages on PyPI for the first time.
